renderer: Matplotlib / static PNG embedded in executed notebooks

charts.question: When did the published gap change relative to SC and pit activity?
charts.takeaway: Descriptive timing context; no independent pit or tyre effect identified.
charts.palette: hard two-root cap: blue timing, gold hatched SC candidates
charts.non_colour: hatch and separate driver pit marker shapes
charts.fallback: table if fewer than eight timing samples

charts.question: How do candidate same-lap differences compare before/after SC?
charts.takeaway: Paired differences and their median are conditional on provisional selection.
charts.family: ordered dot plot / two small multiples
charts.palette: single-root blue with neutral zero line
charts.non_colour: explicit signs, phase panels, dashed medians, equal y-axis
charts.fallback: display sample counts and suppress summary below five pairs

charts.question: Which compounds and starting ages occur in the main pair stints?
charts.takeaway: Tyre age and compound are context; no isolated tyre effect claimed.
charts.non_colour: direct compound and age labels; driver rows
